message: The other day, I was in the kitchen trying to whip up dinner when I realized my kids were playing with the smoke alarm. I mean, they were pretending it was a spaceship! After a brief chat about why we need smoke alarms, we turned it into a fun game where they practiced our escape plan. It was a great reminder that safety can be a family affair, and it’s okay to make it a little fun. How do you involve your kids in safety plans?
